title: Confirmed designs registry — the ONLY source of truth for what is developer-confirmed

rules.R1: frontend/confirmed/ contains ONLY confirmed designs, organized per page in its own subfolder (dashboard/, portfolio/, mobile/...). Anything not confirmed stays in the track worktrees and MUST NOT appear here.
rules.R2: REWORK on a confirmed item updates the SAME file IN PLACE (overwrite the existing file in its subfolder). Never create a new parallel file, new version folder, or copy — in-place only, so the confirmed set never fragments.
rules.R3: Every future agent reads this INDEX first to know what is confirmed, its source, and its pending-rework state. New folders are created here only when the developer confirms a page.
rules.R4: A page enters this folder only on explicit developer confirmation. Status field tracks: confirmed | rework-pending (confirmed but developer requested changes) | superseded.
rules.R5: FULL DETAIL PACKAGE per confirmed page (D16, developer: 'full detail and everything'): page HTML (web+mobile) with all feedback fixes applied, design tokens, component inventory, navigation/flow references, research references, INDEX entry. Nothing left for implementers to guess. PM runs the completeness check and reports missing pieces to the developer BEFORE the page counts as fully confirmed.
rules.R6: Merge target = BASE branch front-design-upgrade (NOT dev). Every confirmed design package merges into front-design-upgrade. Worker branches design-track-a / design-track-b are NEVER merged. Pushes to dev happen only to share briefs/specs with the track worktrees — the confirmed home is front-design-upgrade.
